Caption: 

----------
GM, data enthusiasts! We hope you’re enjoying some sun while you still can! We recently launched [The Latent](https://thelatent.co/), our sister site covering AI. You can sign up for [The Latent Daily](https://thelatent.co/newsletter) to follow the biggest stories in AI.

This week, we’re taking a look at Robinhood Chain activity and perpetuals. We’ll also look at RWA diversity, NFTs, and VC deals. So grab a drink, take a seat, and let’s dive in.


----------———————————————————————————

----------
# ==1: RWA Chain Diversity==


----------View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/52ebd6b0-0423-41e2-b813-364a2cd3145d/RWA_Market_Cap_by_Blockchain_Share.png?t=1792420790)
Follow image link: (https://www.theblock.co/data/decentralized-finance/real-world-assets/rwa-market-cap-by-blockchain-market-share)
Caption: 

----------
**Key Insights** provided by The Block Research

* As market cap for RWAs grows, where these assets live becomes increasingly competitive. Ethereum was and continues to be the most dominant chain for RWAs, commanding over 40% of the market cap today.

  * However, Ethereum’s market share is actually down nearly 30 percentage points from a year ago, when it held nearly three-quarters of the market.

* Other competing chains like Solana, BNB, Stellar, and Avalanche have all carved up Ethereum’s position, each gaining 6 percentage points on average in the last 12 months.

  * This diversity supports competition and is likely to continue as RWAs compete. Because tokenization has minimal fees, competition comes down to distribution and adoption. Partnerships with different blockchains to distribute your assets and build integrations are speeding up as more companies look to enter.

* One caveat to remember: it is not enough to simply have the largest market capitalization. Without people actually trading, borrowing, or lending the shares, there’s little real adoption.

* Despite tokenized stock market capitalization surging past $3 billion, only about 10% is actively used in DeFi. As regulators worldwide provide more clarity on tokenizing stocks, adoption of tokenized equities across DeFi venues will continue.

🧠 Crypto News Brief: Bitcoin steadies near $83K as macro jitters ease, while Wall Street digs deeper on-chain: JPMorgan takes its deposit token to Ethereum and treasury firms keep stacking. Exploits and tax fights keep risk in view. 🏦 JPMorgan Brings JPM Coin to Ethereum JPMorgan is extending JPM Coin (JPMD), its token representing U.S. dollar deposits at the bank, to the Ethereum mainnet for institutional clients. The deposit token debuted on Coinbase's Base network in November 2025; the bank says Ethereum's deeper liquidity and its existing use by institutions for tokenized assets made it the natural next home, adding a cash leg alongside JPMorgan's tokenized money market funds already on the network. Read full story 📈 Bitcoin Tags $83K on China GDP Beat and Chip Rebound Bitcoin briefly pushed above $83,000 before settling around $82,500, after holding support near $81,000 over the weekend. The move came as China's third-quarter GDP topped forecasts, chip stocks led a rebound after last week's AI-driven sell-off, and oil slid back from five-month highs, easing pressure on risk assets. More details 🟠 Strategy Buys 267 BTC, Strive Adds 1,223 BTC Strategy disclosed a modest 267 BTC purchase for $22.1 million, lifting its holdings to a record 848,517 BTC, while spending about $193 million buying back STRC preferred shares and raising its buyback authorization to $3 billion. Strive bought 1,223 BTC for roughly $100 million at about $81,734 per coin, bringing its treasury to 36,818 BTC and cementing its spot among the top public holders. Read more 📊 CME Lines Up Bitcoin Cash and Uniswap Futures CME Group is set to begin offering Bitcoin Cash and Uniswap futures from Monday, pending regulatory review, in both standard (250 BCH / 10,000 UNI) and micro (25 BCH / 1,000 UNI) sizes. The contracts would give U.S. funds regulated tools to hedge or short these tokens and expand CME's single-asset crypto futures lineup to 11 products. See details 🔓 Qubic Halts Mainnet After Weak-Seed Wallet Drain An attacker drained 1,404 Qubic wallets of about 2.94 trillion QU (roughly $1.4 million) by exploiting predictable recovery seeds generated in Apple browsers and early versions of the Qubic iOS app. The network was halted; 87.1% of the stolen tokens remain frozen on-chain and the rest was frozen at MEXC, while the core team prepares a recovery plan for a validator
